name: SOSA specification examples: Systems (Sensors, Actuators, Samplers)
abstract: Examples from the SOSA/SSN specification whose root resource is a systems (sensors, actuators, samplers) resource. Each Turtle example is validated against the SHACL rules of `ogc.sosa.properties.system`, and converted to JSON-LD by the `ttl-to-jsonld` transform, whose output is validated against the `ogc.sosa.properties.system` building block (JSON Schema, JSON-LD context and SHACL).
